RE-DERIVED 2026-07-25 for the reSIDfp engine. The previous 250 bound was measured at 69 ms/sec against the SIDLite build, which the fidelity work showed is not what a C64 sounds like (docs/plans/sid-station/AUDIO-FIDELITY-TEST.md); the vendored artifact is now real reSIDfp, a full analogue model with a sinc resampler, and costs ~5.7x more. This is a deliberate, understood consequence of a deliberate engine change, not a regression being papered over -- the old pin's own note says to re-measure once reSIDfp is vendored. Measured on device over a bounded 35 s run: p99 stable at 388-395 ms/sec (not a cold-start artifact) with ZERO underruns, i.e. ~2.5x realtime. Pinned at 500 to leave ~27% variance headroom while still failing on any regression that would threaten realtime. RISK: the Callback 8020 (SailfishOS) is the perf floor and has never run this engine -- gate L1. If it cannot hold realtime there, the native path costed in AUDIO-FIDELITY-TEST.md 6.4 becomes necessary.
